issue.title: Several @file+id targets on one capture line
issue.description: One capture line may name several existing tasks with adjacent `@route+block-id` markers. Its note text, the bullets below it, and every operation on the line (clipboard notes, `s:`/`$`, `#type`, `&`/`*`/`~`, Ensure Next, `!` toggle, drawers) then apply to each named task in one atomic capture. `bob capture`, `capture-parse`, `capture-complete`, and `capture-rewrite` agree on the grammar, and Bob Mac Capture keeps working unchanged.
